event_name: 2026 Ultimate Orienteer #3 - Lord Hill Park Score-O
event_notes: Archived event page labels the venue as "Lord Hill Regional Park – South Entrance"; canonical venue resolved to "Lord Hill Regional Park".
event_comments:
Unfortunately, control #132 was missing today. Based on individual reports, some people have been given credit for this control. If you think you should get credit, email epunch@cascadeoc.org and let us know which control you visited immediately preceding #132.
If you received credit but think you shouldn't please let us know that as well.
Thank you to all volunteers for helping make this event a success!
Result status codes: MSP = missing punch; DNF = did not finish; NC = not competing; DQ = disqualified; OVT = overtime; DNS = did not start.
Source note: a starred time indicates course completion status was not reported and may be valid, MSP, or DNF.
cumulative_event_comments: Archived event page says December's Bog Slog was canceled due to floods, so this score-o combines that rescheduled idea with Ultimate Orienteer #3.
